sections.Profile:
The "Discotek" pinball machine, released by Bally Manufacturing Co. in September 1965, is a two-player, electro-mechanical game with a music and dancing theme. Designed by Ted Zale, it features three flippers, three pop bumpers, seven mushroom bumpers, a single slingshot, and a ball kicker.

- Manufacturer: Bally Manufacturing Co.
- Years made: 1965
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
- Tags: Two player, Good Times, Dancing, Original Theme, Music
